description: This record groups 1 public transport feed listing(s) attributed to Société des Transports Intercommunaux de Bruxelles/Maatschappij voor het Intercommunaal Vervoer te Brussel (STIB / MIVB) in the official Mobility Database inventory. The recorded geographic coverage is City of Brussels, country code BE. The listing status counts on 2026-10-07 are 1 inactive. Formats are GTFS. GTFS schedule feeds describe transit services for network and timetable modelling; GTFS Realtime listings identify operational update feeds where present. Each retained feed has its own catalogue-page link and provider endpoint when supplied without embedded access parameters. Licence information is recorded from the inventory; feed-use costs are not stated. Authentication requirements follow the source fields. Inactive, deprecated, future and development listings must not be treated as currently operating services. The feed contents, service dates and completeness were not inspected. These metadata support selecting inputs for public transport network and capacity studies.
